reason: A DSH plugin discovery tool that retrieves public plugin metadata, ranks and recommends plugins, exposes search and trend views, and provides optional installation and update actions.

summaries.zh: 一个通过公开元数据提供 DSH 插件排行、搜索、推荐和趋势查看，并支持可选安装与更新操作的插件发现工具。
summaries.en: A DSH plugin discovery tool that uses public metadata to provide rankings, search, recommendations, trend views, and optional installation and update actions.

capabilities: Fetches public GitHub repository metadata and registry data
Provides ranking, search, filtering, recommendation, and trend tools
Displays plugin rankings and details in a DSH settings panel and static site
Can initiate DSH plugin installation and, after user action, execute the official plugin update command
